noRegretTrunk.definition: The selected Fawn product starts with shared durable browser work above Chromium. Independent native application adoption remains a separate product track; neither is a prerequisite for the other.

workItems.requiredOutcome: The shared service passes durable authority and uncertain-action recovery acceptance across reusable workflows, then establishes complete-task value against competent stock Chromium/Playwright. Native runtime wins are not a prerequisite.

internalCausalLanes.isolates: legacy Fawn shell build and agent-facing browser behavior
DoeRuntime beneath the same Fawn surface
Direct Protocol beyond the Fawn plus DoeRuntime control

externalComparators.freshnessRule: Reverify both official sources before every funded fork decision or published comparison.
externalComparators.claimBoundary: Cloudflare product documentation establishes comparator scope only; it is not Doe, Fawn workspace or legacy Fawn shell build execution evidence.

suites.purpose: Compare substitutable product outcomes without treating K0 as an internal component lane.
Test whether persistent local browser operation creates customer value outside Kitesurf's documented fit.

independenceTests.requiredInterpretation: DoeProof records independent evidence for the incumbent as a supporting feature; W0 value alone does not establish primary-product adoption.
Only a B-over-A application outcome grants legacy Fawn shell build value.
independenceTests.forbiddenInference: Legacy Fawn shell build value grants DoeRuntime or Direct Protocol value.

independenceTests.requiredInterpretation: Only a C-over-B application outcome grants DoeRuntime browser value for the measured tuple.
independenceTests.forbiddenInference: A DoeRuntime result generalizes across applications, hardware, operating systems, drivers, or providers.

independenceTests.requiredInterpretation: Only a D-over-C total task outcome funds the Direct Protocol for the measured workload.
independenceTests.forbiddenInference: Lower token count alone grants Direct Protocol value.

independenceTests.requiredInterpretation: K0 compares external product outcomes and never changes the causal meaning of A/B/C/D.
independenceTests.forbiddenInference: A K0 result identifies the value of a legacy Fawn shell build or DoeRuntime component.

forkAuthorities.fundWhen: Independent qualification and replay make incumbent and DoeRuntime evidence comparable without changing execution.
forkAuthorities.stopWhen: Observation interferes with execution, hides fallback, or is treated as a substitute for runtime adoption.

forkAuthorities.fundWhen: Implement and independently qualify the selected shared workspace service above stock Chromium, then compare complete workflows against competent Chromium/Playwright; native runtime wins are not prerequisites.
forkAuthorities.stopWhen: Unsafe authority or recovery blocks acceptance; failure to improve complete workflows rejects product-value claims. K0 outcomes retain their external-comparator scope.

forkAuthorities.fundWhen: C beats B materially, the exact D0 tuple also beats W0 and every authorized P0, and the measured benefit justifies the integration's compatibility and maintenance costs.
forkAuthorities.stopWhen: C does not beat B or a governed incumbent meets the application outcome at lower durable cost.

forkAuthorities.fundWhen: D beats C on the complete task outcome under the same oracle and lifecycle scope, and the measured benefit justifies the hook's compatibility and maintenance costs.
forkAuthorities.stopWhen: D does not beat C or reduces tokens while worsening the customer's declared total task outcome.

stopConditions: Reject the measured shell-product claim when K0 wins shared tasks and customers do not value differentiation; workspace acceptance remains independently governed.
Do not grant legacy Fawn shell build value unless B beats A.
Do not grant DoeRuntime browser ownership unless C beats B for the exact measured tuple.
Do not continue Direct Protocol funding unless D beats C on the declared total task outcome.
Do not add Chromium hooks or browser-runtime integration unless measured benefits justify their compatibility and maintenance costs.

workspaceComparison.scope: Prospective independent workflow comparison; existing A/B/C/D and K0 receipts retain their meanings and cannot satisfy it.

alternativeCompleteSystem.treatment: Fawn workspace with explicitly integrated, independently qualified Doppler+Doe local execution

alternatives.browser: stock Chromium driven by Playwright, without Doe
alternatives.treatmentQuantization: Doppler RDRR q4k weights with f16 embeddings and head, f32 activations

alternatives.admissionRequirement: Establish its actual execution path (bundled engine, version and GPU backend on the target) and workload eligibility before any run.
Establish its actual execution path (runtime, version and GPU backend on the target) and workload eligibility before any run.

alternativeCompleteSystem.claimBoundary: A complete-system result compares whole local systems on the initial qualification target under matched conditions; it cannot isolate Doe's compiler or runtime, grants no provider attribution, and does not replace Doppler+Doe versus Doppler+Dawn.

claimBoundary: This policy defines experiments and decisions. Until schema-valid physical receipts exist, K0 and A/B/C/D have no promoted comparative product outcome.
